## Description

Briefly describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Type of Change

- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] Heuristic enhancement (improving project detection or authorship verification)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Test addition or enhancement

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] My change complies with the **5 Hard Rules** (zero hallucinated metrics, read-only on project folders).
- [ ] Single-page layout constraint is preserved (`references/layout-spec.md`).
- [ ] All tests pass locally (`python tests/run_all.py`).
- [ ] New tests were added covering the new behavior or edge case.
- [ ] Documentation and example files were updated if applicable.
- [ ] Tested on at least one sample project folder.
